name: input-entry-buttons
summary: OS-injected click of each Mods entry button (main-menu at the main menu; top-tab when connected), then the close control. Evidence label os-injected; not handler-invocation.
notes: Acceptance procedure — not run. `--side client`. Evidence: os-injected (observe.ps1 SendInput). Never mark this as handler-invocation or physical.

Main-menu run (`world` main-menu, `--site main-menu`): click `mainMenuButton` (live id `main-menu`). Connected run (`--site top-tab`): click `topTab` (live id `top-tab`; FullscreenMenu must be up so that rect is visible; the opening `mods_ui open` / `close` pair is handler-invocation setup to attach the button, then the click under test is os-injected).

observe.ps1 click uses client-area pixels, focuses the target, and refuses a locked workstation (exit 3). Prerequisite: unlocked session, game window can be brought to the foreground. `-AllowGameInput` is required.
Close is the owned close control (`close` → live id `close-back`), not a separate back id. Closed after-state: open=false, curtain=false, modsCapture=false, panes equal the recorded baseline.
